definition: Garbage collection automatically reclaims memory that the program can no longer reach. A tracing collector finds objects reachable from roots and frees the rest. The alternative is explicit freeing, which can free too early or not at all.
details: Reference counting frees an object when its last reference drops, and it needs a separate treatment of cycles. A tracing collector finds cycles and usually pauses the program briefly.
examples: Objects freed after the last variable referring to them goes away
A generational collector that scans new objects more often
